text: A Song of the Ascents. 1 To YHWH, in the distress for me, I cried out, and He answered me.
O YHWH, deliver my soul from a lip of falsehood, from a tongue of deceit!
What will He give to you, or what will He add to you, O tongue of deceit?
The sharpened arrows of a mighty one, with the burning coals of broom trees!
Woe to me for I have sojourned [in] Mesech; I have dwelt among the tents of Kedar!
Too much has dwelt my soul with the one hating peace!
I [am] peace, and when I speak, they [are] for war.
